def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    b=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    greens=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>=8:

            greens.append(((r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2, b[(r0+r1)//2][(c0+c1)//2]))

        if n['color']=='p':
            r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]; r1,c1=n['boundary'][2]
            out['purple']=f"rows{r0}-{r1} cols{c0}-{c1}"
    return out
print('before', state())
